2026-07-10: S12 fix: FastAPI's auto-generated docs_url/openapi_url/redoc_url routes are registered via add_route() (plain Starlette routing), which bypasses FastAPI's dependency-injection system -- so the `dependencies=[Depends(verify_api_key), Depends(rate_limit)]` passed to the FastAPI() constructor never applied to /api/v1/tts/docs or /api/v1/tts/openapi. Confirmed empirically pre-fix: both returned 200 with no Authorization header, and even when tts_api_enabled=False. Fix: disabled docs_url/openapi_url/redoc_url on the FastAPI() constructor and added explicit GET /openapi and GET /docs routes on `router` (which is include_router'd into the sub-app and therefore inherits the same verify_api_key + rate_limit dependencies as every data route, e.g. /engines, /synthesize, /jobs/{id}). Verified: 401 unauthenticated, 403 when tts_api_enabled=False, 200 with a valid key -- matching every other route's behavior.
